hypothesis_status: Unconfirmed. Fake-Rig tests verify command and guard semantics; they do not show that startup settling fixes native or learned hardware failures.
limitations: No hardware or deployment occurred; no hardware qualification or stability claim.
Zero phase is measured in board time from the first post-ARM callback, not from the host ARM call. The unchanged host duration still bounds the whole run.
A run whose total duration expires before board-time handoff reports its phase/counts; the wrapper does not extend the duration.
The historical successful native baseline reportedly used bandwidth 8 while current bandwidth is 10; root is investigating this independently. This harness does not change either value.
The candidate is a supervised approximation of actual filtered BAL feedback, not a PPO improvement.
Only focused and adjacent tests were run for this task. Parent reports the full production suite separately.
purpose: Local-only harness for a future matched comparison of immediate feedback and explicit 200ms zero-command settling using the same frozen filtered learned actor.

semantics.default_behavior: Exact delegation to existing run_balance_policy with unchanged arguments.
semantics.during_zero: Require fresh healthy homed switch-profile telemetry, fresh selected and raw channels, <=10ms raw/selected skew, unchanged saved upright reference, START_LIMITS cart position/speed/brake, raw angle <=10 degrees and angular rate <=3 rad/s. Enforce normal 100Hz cadence.
semantics.finally: STOP in finally, including refusal and exception paths.
semantics.handoff: At first observation at or after 200ms, require the standard full start guard immediately. No extending or retrying the handoff. Reset only actor cadence history, then invoke unchanged actor and guards.
semantics.no_writes: No calibration, parameter, reference, home, physical model or actor weight writes.
semantics.phase_time_origin: First post-ARM policy observation board timestamp; the normal full start guard runs before ARM. In stopped shadow, the first shadow observation is the origin.
semantics.recording: Boundary, zero-phase start, transfer or refusal, all phase commands, and ordinary SDK action requests/transitions.
semantics.total_duration: Includes settling; >=0.25 seconds for the 200ms intervention, with existing duration/profile bounds and stop reserve unchanged. No extension.

verification.cli_help: Executed --help successfully without connecting to hardware.
coverage: 20 zero requests and no early armed actor inference
standard start guard before ARM and at handoff
bounded enable transient accepted only during zero phase
raw/selected freshness, missing values, timestamp skew and unhealthy/fault telemetry fail closed
position, speed, brake, angle, rate, cadence and reference refusal
duration bounds and no waiting extension
